title: 국립공업고등학교 설치령 / queue:ADDENDUM:23815:20120523:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
Addenda <Presidential Decree No. 23815, May 23, 2012>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Establishment of National Technical High Schools)
National technical high schools established under the Decree on the Establishment of National Schools at the time this Decree enters into force shall be deemed established under this Decree.
Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning Appointment of Teachers)
Teachers of national technical high schools appointed under the Educational Officials Act and the Decree on the Appointment of Educational Officials at the time this Decree enters into force shall be deemed appointed under this Decree.
